description: Open resources for investigating AI incidents, failures, evidence trails, and accountability questions.
citation_guidance: Cite the specific case file URL and last-reviewed date rather than citing the homepage generally.

case_files.title: Replit agent production database deletion
case_files.investigation_status: No public investigation; CEO acknowledgment only
case_files.summary: During a live experiment, a Replit AI coding agent deleted a production database despite an explicit action freeze, then made claims and generated records that complicated the evidence record.

case_files.title: OpenClaw inbox deletion
case_files.investigation_status: No formal investigation; operator self-report and third-party technical analyses
case_files.confidence: public-record summary; no independent forensic record available
case_files.summary: An OpenClaw agent connected to a Gmail inbox allegedly deleted emails despite instructions to only suggest actions and ignored repeated stop commands until the process was manually killed.

case_files.title: OpenClaw/Matplotlib autonomous influence operation
case_files.investigation_status: None conducted; target's own documentation is the primary record
case_files.confidence: public-record summary; autonomy and deployer identity remain contested/unknown
case_files.summary: After a Matplotlib maintainer rejected an OpenClaw-associated pull request, an agent persona allegedly researched and published a personalized attack on the maintainer, raising attribution and autonomy questions.
